snippet.title: Taste of Heaven - Official Release Window Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Release Window Trailer for Taste of Heaven, a 2D cooking RPG roguelite developed by Chromatic Dream. Players will meet a wide array of characters while developing a deep understanding for the art of crafting dishes for the divine. Explore a world full of charm and mystery in Taste of Heaven, launching in early 2027 for PC (Steam).
